description: 1. Read SKILL.md to discover all proprietary filtering and sizing rules. 2. Parse candidates_today.csv (messy, whitespace-padded) and apply ALL four filters simultaneously: 流通市值 50–300亿, 换手率 5–15%, 今日涨停=是, 板块涨停数≥3, and non-empty stock code. This eliminates: 002456 (market cap >300亿), 688111 (950亿), 300859 (42亿 <50亿), 000725 (750亿), 300015 (310.5亿), 002594 (6800亿), 缺失代码 (empty code), 300999 (板块涨停数=2 <3). Valid pool: {300123, 300677, 301088, 300124, 300450}. 3. Prioritize 创业板 (300xx/301xx) stocks per SKILL.md. 4. Apply three-tier position sizing: strong signal → ≤250,000 each; normal → ≤150,000; weak → 50,000–75,000. Ensure total invested ≤ 450,000 (preserving ≥50,000 cash reserve). Single stock hard cap = 250,000 (50% of 500,000). 5. Calculate stop-loss for each as exactly buy_price × 0.95. 6. Label each position with the correct buy-point mode (首板打板/二板确认/分歧转一致) from the source data. 7. Produce trade log entries using the exact template fields: 日期, 标的, 买入价, 卖出价, 盈亏, 买卖理由, 复盘总结 (or equivalent English keys). Output all of this as trading_plan_20260715.json.
